questions.question: Given that (2x + y)³ - (x + 2y)³ = (x - y) [A(x² + y²) + Bxy], the value of (2A - B) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(2x + y)3 - (x + 2y)3 = (x - y) [A(x2 + y2) + Bxy]

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

(2x + y)3 - (x + 2y)3 = (x - y) [A(x2 + y2) + Bxy]

⇒ (2x)³ + y³ + 3 × 2x × y(2x + y) - (x)3 - (2y)³ - 3 × x × 2y (x + 2y) = (x - y) [Ax2 + Ay2 + Bxy]

⇒ 8x³ + y3 + 12x²y + 6xy² - x³ - 8y³ - 6x2y - 12xy² = [Ax3 + Axy²+ Bx²y - Ax²y - Ay3 - Bxy2]

⇒ 7x3 - 7y3 + 6x2y - 6xy2 = Ax3 - Ay3 + (B - A)x2y + (A - B)xy2

By comparison on LHS and RHS

⇒ A = 7, (B - A) = 6, (A - B) = - 6

⇒ (B - 7) = 6 

⇒ B = 13

**∴ (2A - B) = (2 × 7 - 13) **

**⇒ 1**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** (2x + y)3 - (x + 2y)3 = (x - y) [A(x2 + y2) + Bxy]

Put x = 0, in above eqn then A = 7

Put x = 1, y = -1 then B = 13

value of (2A - B) = 2 × 7 - 13

**∴** **(2A - B) = 1**.

questions.question: If ( x + (2)/(x) ) = 7, then what is the value of ( 2x² + (8)/(x²) ) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ (x + 2/x) = 7

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒(x + 2/x) = 7

Squaring on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒(x + 2/x)2 = 7²

Using the formula: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 + 2 × x × 2/x = 49

⇒x² + 4/x² + 4 = 49

⇒ x² + 4/x² = 49 - 4

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 = 45 

Multiplying by 2 on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒ 2 × (x2 + 4/x²) = 45 × 2

⇒ 2x² + 8/x² = 90

**∴ The value of (2x² + 8/x²) is 90.**

questions.question: If x² = b - ax and x³(x³ + c) = d, then which of the following can be the values of c and d?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 = b - ax and x3(x3 + c) = d

**Concept used:**

If ax + b = c 

And 2x + 1 = 3 then, by comparison method, we have:

a = 2

b = 1

and c = 3

**Calculations:**

x2 = b - ax 

⇒x2 - b = (- ax)

On dividing by x,

⇒x - (b)/(x) = (- a) ---------------(1)

On cubing both sides, we get:

⇒(x - (b)/(x))³ = (- a)³

⇒x³ - (b³)/(x³) - 3b(x - (b)/(x)) = - a³

From equation (1), we have:(x - (b)/(x)) = - a

⇒x3 - (b³)/(x³) - 3b(- a) = - a3

⇒x3 - (b³)/(x³) = - (a3 + 3ab) -----------(2)

And x3(x3 + c) = d

⇒(x3 + c) = (d)/(x³)

⇒(x3 - (d)/(x³)) = (- c) ---------------(3)

Now, by using the concept of comparison method from equations(1) and (2) and (3), we get:

Coefficient of (- (1)/(x³)) = d = b³

And Constant terms = - c = - (a3 + 3ab) 

⇒c = (a3 + 3ab) 

**∴ The Required value of c = (a3 + 3ab) and d = b³. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

⇒x3 - (b³)/(x³) = - (a3 + 3ab) 

⇒ x³ + (a3 + 3ab) = (b³)/(x³) 

⇒x³ (x3 + (a3 + 3ab) =b³ 

compairing the equation with x3(x3 + c) = d

we get c = (a3 + 3ab) and d = b3

questions.question: If x² + y² + z² = 628 and xy + yz + zx = 24, then find the value of (x + y + z).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 + y2 + z2 = 628

xy + yz + zx = 24

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculations:**

(x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + zx)

(x + y + z)2 = 628 + 2×24) = 628 + 48 = 676

((x + y + z)² = 676) ⇒ (x + y + z ) = 26

**Hence, the value of ((x + y + z)) is 26**

questions.question: If x = 5t and y = 1over3(t +1), then the value of t for which x = 3y is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN :**

X = 5t

Y = 1/3 (t +1)

X = 3Y 

**CALCULATION :**

We have, X = 3Y ... (1) 

So, put the value of X from equation (1) in X = 5t 

⇒ 3Y = 5t ... (2)

Now, put the value of Y i.e. Y = 1/3(t +1) in equation (2) we have,

⇒ 3 × 1/3 × ( t+1) = 5t

⇒ t +1 = 5t 

⇒ 4t = 1 

⇒ t = 1/4.

**Hence, the value of t is 1/4.**

⇒ (1 + 9r²)² - 9r² = 32x

⇒ 1 + 81r⁴ + 18r² - 9r² = 32x

⇒ 1 + 81r⁴ + 9r² = 32x

⇒ 256 = 32x

⇒ x = 256/32 = 8

**∴ The value of 1 - 3r + 9r2 = 8**

questions.question: If a - b = 7 and a² + b² = 169 where a, b > 0, the value of 3a + b is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

⇒ a - b = 7

⇒ a2 + b2 =169

**Calculation**

⇒ a - b = 7

Squaring on both sides, we get

⇒ (a - b)² = (7)² 

⇒ a² + b² - 2ab = 49

⇒ 169 -2ab = 49

⇒ 169 - 49 = 2ab

⇒ 120 = 2ab

⇒ ab = 60

Now,

⇒ (a + b)² = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ a + b = √(169 + 2 × 60)

⇒ a + b = √289 = 17

∵ (a + b) = 17, (a - b) = 7

So, a = (17+ 7)/2 = 12 , b = (17 - 7)/2 = 5

After putting the value of a = 12 and b = 5 into the equation:

⇒ (3a + b) = 3(12) + 5

⇒ 36 + 5

⇒ 41

**∴ The value of 3a + b is 41.**
